description: Estimate daily calorie needs (IOM Estimated Energy Requirement) and return the USDA MyPlate food-group plan at that level — cups of fruit/vegetables/dairy, ounce-equivalents of grains/protein, plus weekly vegetable & protein subgroup targets and BMI. From age, sex, height, weight and activity (pregnancy/lactation optional).

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

edition.description: DRI Estimated Energy Requirement equation set. Defaults to iom2005.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

lactation.description: Lactation status (adds the IOM lactation calorie allowance).

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status (adds the IOM trimester calorie allowance).

sex.description: Biological sex — drives the energy equation.

name: calculate_myplate_plan
title: Calculate a USDA MyPlate food-pattern plan
